    def ik(self, targets: dict, seed=None, base_pose=None, **opts) -> dict:
        """Inverse kinematics: {frame: [x,y,z, quat]} (frames from spec()['kinematics']['ik_targets']) and an optional seed q ->

        body = {"op": "ik", "targets": {k: [float(v) for v in p] for k, p in targets.items()}, **opts}

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Episode controller for the MolmoSpaces soap bottle task."""
+import time
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/output"
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+DT = 0.198  # three control periods
+
+
+def current():
+    o = r.get_obs(depth=True)
+    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return o, p[:7], p[22:29]
+
+
+def save_obs(o, tag):
+    for cam, im in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"{OUT}/{tag}_{cam}.png")
+
+
+def solve_line(start_pose, goal_pose, qseed, spacing=0.035):
+    a = np.asarray(start_pose[:3], dtype=float)
+    b = np.asarray(goal_pose[:3], dtype=float)
+    n = max(2, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/spacing)))
+    qs = []
+    seed = np.asarray(qseed, dtype=float)
+    for i in range(1, n+1):
+        t = i/n
+        pose = [*(a*(1-t)+b*t), *goal_pose[3:]]
+        ik = r.ik({"gripper": pose}, seed=seed)
+        if not ik.get("ok"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed at {pose}: {ik}")
+        seed = np.asarray(ik["q"], dtype=float)
+        qs.append(seed.copy())
+    return np.asarray(qs)
+
+
+def move_pose(goal, grip=0, spacing=0.035, cameras=None):
+    o, q, tcp = current()
+    qs = solve_line(tcp, goal, q, spacing)
+    actions = np.column_stack((qs, np.full(len(qs), float(grip))))
+    cams = cameras or ["wrist_camera_zed_mini", "randomized_zed2_analogue_1"]
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=DT, cameras=cams, video="none")
+    print("move", len(qs), "rows; steps_left", res.meta.get("steps_left"),
+          "tcp", np.round(res.meta["proprio"]["now"][22:25], 3))
+    save_obs(res, f"stage{r.status()['calls']}")
+    return res
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    o, q, tcp = current()
+    save_obs(o, "initial")
+    print("status", r.status())
+    print("tcp", tcp)
+    quat = tcp[3:]
+    pregrasp = [4.94, 0.78, 1.28, *quat]
+    move_pose(pregrasp, grip=0, spacing=0.03)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

"""Episode controller for the MolmoSpaces soap bottle task."""
import time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = "/app/output"
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
DT = 0.198  # three control periods


def current():
    o = r.get_obs(depth=True)
    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    return o, p[:7], p[22:29]


def save_obs(o, tag):
    for cam, im in o.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"{OUT}/{tag}_{cam}.png")


def solve_line(start_pose, goal_pose, qseed, spacing=0.035):
    a = np.asarray(start_pose[:3], dtype=float)
    b = np.asarray(goal_pose[:3], dtype=float)
    n = max(2, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/spacing)))
    qs = []
    seed = np.asarray(qseed, dtype=float)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        t = i/n
        pose = [*(a*(1-t)+b*t), *goal_pose[3:]]
        ik = r.ik({"gripper": pose}, seed=seed)
        if not ik.get("ok"):
            raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed at {pose}: {ik}")
        seed = np.asarray(ik["q"], dtype=float)
        qs.append(seed.copy())
    return np.asarray(qs)


def move_pose(goal, grip=0, spacing=0.035, cameras=None, settle=5):
